last_material_result: One bounded build-readiness/schema validation passed. Current Korean moving-cost and quote-comparison sources repeatedly converge on a compact set of material cost/scope dimensions: base labor/vehicle, distance/load, ladder truck by floor/tonnage, elevator/access conditions, appliance or special-item installation/handling, cleaning/disposal/packing extras, storage, and date/season premium. These can be represented without OCR, AI, backend or authoritative market-price claims by using 2-3 quote columns with per-row status {included in quote / separately quoted amount / unspecified / not needed}, optional user-entered amount, and one free-text 'other item' row. Normalized total = quoted base + explicitly separate amounts + user-entered risk allowances only; unspecified rows are flagged rather than silently priced. This supports materially different quote formats while keeping manual entry bounded to roughly 8-10 rows. Build-readiness therefore survives: the product can be a genuinely usable static v1 rather than a smoke page.
